snippet.title: PINBOMB - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
PINBOMB is a pinball roguelike that traps you in a room with a merciless machine hungry for higher scores. Buy new parts, chain wild synergies to send your points through the roof, and race the bomb strapped to the table before it detonates.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4869310?curator_clanid=46009612
